privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Sentra AI (“Sentra”, “we”, “us”) provides AI-assisted security analytics for camera systems, optional phone and messaging alerts, and optional human monitoring / live camera review for sites you authorize. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share and protect personal and related data when you use our marketing website, apps and services.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: The controller of personal data for this website and related services is Sentra AI, operated by {{company}}. For privacy requests, contact {{email}}.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Account and contact data: name, email, phone number, company/site details and messages you submit via demo or contact forms.
Service and camera data: camera streams, snapshots, event metadata, site configuration, detection results and analytics generated by our AI when you connect cameras.
Alert and communication data: WhatsApp/SMS/call logs, notification preferences and emergency-contact details you provide.
Optional human monitoring data: when you enable a monitoring team, authorized operators may view live or recorded footage and related event information to verify incidents.
Payment data (when enabled): billing identity, plan, invoices and payment status processed by our payment provider. We do not store full card numbers on our servers.
Technical data: IP address, device/browser type, approximate location, cookies and similar technologies used for site operation and analytics.

sections.title: 3. How we use data
paragraphs: To provide AI monitoring, threat verification, false-alarm filtering and site analytics.
To send optional alerts by messaging apps and phone calls when events meet your rules.
To enable optional human review and response when you subscribe to monitoring services.
To respond to sales, support and demo requests.
To process subscriptions and payments when checkout is available.
To improve safety, reliability, fraud prevention and product quality (including limited model evaluation on authorized data).
To comply with law and enforce our Terms of Use and Site Rules.

sections.title: 4. Legal bases (where applicable)
paragraphs: Depending on your location, we process data based on contract performance, legitimate interests (securing property and operating the service), consent (optional alerts, marketing cookies where required) and legal obligations.

sections.title: 5. Sharing
paragraphs: We share data with infrastructure, messaging, analytics and payment providers acting on our instructions; with optional monitoring partners only for sites you authorize; and when required by law or to protect rights, safety and security.
We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: 6. Retention
paragraphs: We retain contact inquiries for a reasonable business period; account and billing records for the life of the account plus legal retention periods; and camera/event data according to your plan settings and operational needs, unless a longer period is required by law or dispute resolution.

sections.title: 7. Security
paragraphs: We use administrative, technical and organizational measures appropriate to the sensitivity of security footage and contact data. No method of transmission or storage is fully secure; you remain responsible for securing your cameras, credentials and local networks.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability or objection, and withdraw consent where processing is consent-based. Contact {{email}}. You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

sections.title: 9. Cookies
paragraphs: Our marketing site may use essential cookies and, where permitted, analytics cookies. You can control non-essential cookies through your browser settings.

sections.title: 10. International transfers
paragraphs: Data may be processed in countries other than your own. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers.

sections.title: 11. Children
paragraphs: The service is intended for business and adult users. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16 (or higher age required locally) without appropriate authorization.

sections.title: 12. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this Policy. Material changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Continued use after changes means you accept the revised Policy where permitted by law.

terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to the Sentra AI marketing website, applications and related services for AI camera analytics, optional phone/messaging notifications, optional human monitoring and camera viewing, and future paid subscriptions.

Where enabled, a monitoring team may view authorized site cameras and events to assist verification and response. Features depend on your plan and configuration.
